description: Quiet watcher triage corpus, first slice (docs/specs/quiet-watcher-triage.md §6.2). Synthetic: every name, id, repo and URL is invented (eval-harness D6). Each prompt has the calls its last full run made, with their results as Strands tool results, and variants that replace some results. `tier1` is what the fingerprint must do: `changed` (some call's fingerprint differs), `unchanged` (every fingerprint matches), or `either`. Every P1-P3, P5 and P6 variant must be `changed` (§6.4); P4 is the case tier 1 cannot see.
